info.title: Capability Platform API
info.description: Every request sends Accept naming application/json (and text/event-stream on an operation that can be followed) and, when it has a body, Content-Type naming application/json (and application/x-ndjson on an operation that takes a collection). A request that lacks them is refused before the operation runs: ACCEPT_REQUIRED and CONTENT_TYPE_REQUIRED answer 400, ACCEPT_UNSUPPORTED answers 406 and CONTENT_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED answers 415. OpenAPI ignores Accept and Content-Type as header parameters, so the media types of the request body and of each response say what is accepted.
